correctness.rationale: Full proof for all real h>=1: every sub-unit full chord must connect adjacent sides; constrained least intercept chord has length (x^(2/3)+y^(2/3))^(3/2), and its minimizer is feasible whenever this is <1. Four-corner inequalities exactly describe the maximal locus. Reflection symmetry gives one finite integral; x=cos^3(t) evaluates it explicitly. Monotonicity uses f strictly increasing and the transition exponent follows from H(t)=3t^5/5+O(t^7). The standalone checker corroborates direct quadrature, Monte Carlo area, and explicit angular full chords; computations alone are not proof.
